People: Aristotle (author, Wikidata Q868), died -322; Alfred Berger (other, Wikidata Q88890), died 1912; Theodor Gomperz (translator, Wikidata Q78683), died 1912. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Aristotle, 385 BCE-323 BCE; Berger, Alfred, Freiherr von, 1853-1912 [Contributor]; Gomperz, Theodor, 1832-1912 [Translator]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: Aristoteles' Poetik , Leipzig : Veit, 1897, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/aristotelespoet00berggoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 85%, 92%, 85% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Aristotle, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
